issues.issue: Were the ID's credibility findings and weighing of the evidence reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: ID's credibility findings and weighing of the evidence were unreasonable (para 13).
issues.result_quote: therefore refrain from expressing an opinion on the other issues raised by the Applicant

issues.issue: Did the ID reasonably assess all six Ezokola factors, including the size and nature of the PPS and his rank?
issues.applicant_position: ID's complicity assessment under Ezokola was unreasonable; he was not involved in and did not contribute to the crimes.
issues.respondent_position: Minister submitted Malhi made a voluntary, knowing and significant contribution to the PPS's crimes (para 15).
issues.result_quote: I find the reasons are deficient in at least one respect: the ID failed to consider all six factors from Ezokola

issues.issue: Were the ID's reasons on the significance of his contribution adequate?
issues.applicant_position: His role was restricted and his authority limited; he did not conduct interrogations (para 16).
issues.respondent_position: Minister said Malhi made a significant contribution to the PPS's crimes (para 15).
issues.result_quote: This is sufficient to dispose of the judicial review.
